questions.question: What is a map?
questions.answer: A map is a drawing that represents all or part of Earth's surface.

questions.question: A globe is a model of the Earth.
Which tool shows the Earth in three dimensions?
Fill in the blank: A collection of maps is called an ______.
What is the purpose of a map?
questions.answer: It helps us locate places and understand geographical features.

questions.question: Observe the image and identify the object.
Which image shows a political map?
Maps are generally easier to carry than globes.
Fill in the blank: The imaginary line dividing Earth into the Northern and Southern Hemispheres is the ______.
Which map shows mountains, rivers, and other natural features?
What is a globe?
questions.answer: A globe is a three-dimensional model of the Earth.

questions.question: A political map mainly shows countries, states, and cities.
Observe the image and identify the map type.
Which image represents a compass rose?
Explain one advantage of using a globe instead of a map.
questions.answer: A globe shows the Earth's true shape and relative positions with less distortion.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: A ______ explains the symbols used on a map.
Every map has a title.
Which direction is opposite to east?
Why is a map scale important?
questions.answer: It helps determine the actual distance between places.

questions.question: Explain the differences between a map and a globe.
questions.answer: A map is a flat representation of Earth's surface, while a globe is a three-dimensional model that represents Earth more accurately.
